children: Shaun Anthony Quin, the Chief Executive Officer of Stewards, Inc., disclosed a 9.6% stake in the company’s common stock. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 16, 2026, detailing direct and family-related holdings, including shares controlled through S&T Quin Family Limited Partnership. He also holds an irrevocable proxy to vote Series B Preferred Stock at the founders’ direction, giving him significant voting influence without owning those preferred shares.

Quin holds the shares for investment and in connection with his leadership role. He states, "Mr. Quin participates, as CEO and director, in ordinary Board and management decisions" on business, capitalization, compensation, listing, and governance, and he reports no specific plans beyond routine corporate matters.

A Voting Agreement with Forfront Capital, LLC grants an irrevocable proxy to the company’s President to vote 10,000,000 Series B Preferred shares at the founders’ direction, and "holders of the Series B Preferred Stock collectively control approximately 87% of the total voting power." Quin notes he has no economic interest in those preferred shares but can exercise their votes as proxyholder under that agreement.

Shaun Anthony Quin is the Chief Executive Officer, Principal Executive Officer, and a director of Stewards, Inc., and is one of the company’s founders. He holds shares directly and through S&T Quin Family Limited Partnership, over which he has voting and dispositive control. Quin focuses on long-term company building and governance, using family and personal holdings to align management with shareholder outcomes.
